blurb: Belfair Farms offers personalized hunter/jumper riding lessons for all levels, boarding services with pasture and stall options, and hosts schooling horse shows as well as supports travel to rated competitions. Lessons are 35 minutes long and cost $40 each. Boarding includes access to arenas, trails, and daily care but is not full care.
extraNote: Lessons paid directly to trainer, no packages or monthly commitments · Show costs vary: schooling shows $200-500, local $400-$1,000, rated $1,000+
